Bill.BriefDescription: Exempting certain amateur radio repeaters from leasehold excise taxes.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to exempting certain amateur radio repeaters fromleasehold excise taxes; and adding a new section to chapter 82.29A RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.29A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Any leasehold interest in an amateur radio repeater, which ismade available for use by, or is used in support of, a public agency inthe event of an emergency or potential emergency to which the agencyis, or may be, a qualified responder, is exempt from tax under thischapter or any similar tax imposed for the lease of public property. (2) For purposes of this act, "amateur radio repeater" means anelectronic device that receives a weak or lowlevel amateur radiosignal and retransmits it at a higher level or higher power, so thatthe signal can cover longer distances without degradation, and is usedby amateur radio operators possessing a valid license issued by thefederal communications commission.
